$comment: Prompts for `pnpm imagery --slug activa`. One entry per asset the config references. Dark, warm, no text, no faces — matches the hero treatment in globals.css, which sits a 30% image under a brand-950 scrim.
style: Professional architectural interior photography, warm low-key lighting, amber and charcoal tones, shallow depth of field, clean and precise, Polish single-family home context, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

images.name: hero
images.prompt: Close-up of a modern wall-hung condensing gas boiler with neat copper and brass pipework in a clean utility room, warm amber light raking across brushed metal, deep shadows, cinematic and moody.

images.name: about
images.prompt: Interior aisle of a heating-equipment wholesale warehouse, tall steel shelving stocked with boilers, radiators and boxed fittings, warm pendant lighting, atmospheric depth, portrait orientation.

images.name: service-boiler
images.prompt: Modern condensing gas boiler installed on a tiled wall with a magnetic filter and expansion vessel, tidy pipe runs, soft warm light from one side.

images.name: service-heatpump
images.prompt: Outdoor air-source heat pump unit on a concrete plinth beside a contemporary Polish single-family house at dusk, warm window light, blue hour sky, frost on the grass.

images.name: service-underfloor
images.prompt: Underfloor heating manifold with red and blue PEX pipe loops freshly installed on insulation boards before the screed, warm work light, precise and geometric.

images.name: service-warehouse
images.prompt: Counter and shelves of a heating and plumbing supplies wholesaler, radiators stacked on a rack, boxed valves and fittings, warm daylight through a high window.

images.name: gallery-1
images.prompt: Small residential boiler room with a wall-hung gas boiler, hot-water cylinder and insulated pipework, everything aligned and labelled, warm light.

images.name: gallery-2
images.prompt: Heat pump outdoor unit installed beside a rendered house wall with a gravel bed, evening light, long shadows.

images.name: gallery-3
images.prompt: Top-down view of underfloor heating pipe loops laid in a spiral pattern across a room before screed, warm light, geometric.

images.name: gallery-4
images.prompt: Brass underfloor heating manifold with flow meters and actuators in a cabinet, macro detail, warm reflections.

images.name: gallery-5
images.prompt: Large stainless steel hot-water cylinder with insulated pipes and a circulation pump in a clean plant room, moody warm lighting.

images.name: gallery-6
images.prompt: Vertical designer radiator in anthracite on a pale plastered wall of a modern living room, warm afternoon light, minimal.
